arStrings.szText: {c_important}Thunderspike{/c} generates {c_number}{SF_13}{/c} additional Vigor if you have moved in the last {c_number}{SF_14}{/c} seconds.
After you Critically Strike {c_number}{SF_29}{/c} times, {c_important}Thunderspike's{/c} next use will be its {c_number}3rd{/c} attack and always Critically Strike.
{c_important}Thunderspike{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_30}*100|%|]{/c} increased damage to Sparking enemies.
{c_important}Thunderspike{/c} increases your Movement Speed by {c_number}[{SF_31}*100|%x|]{/c} for {c_number}[{SF_32}]{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Thunderspike's{/c} {c_number}3rd{/c} attack strikes back again for {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_THIRD_PULL}{/c} damage, Pulling in and applying {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} to enemies.
When you {c_important}Evade{/c}, you attack with {c_important}Thunderspike{/c} along the way for {c_number}[SF_15*100|%|]{/c} of normal damage.

{c_important}Thunderspike{/c} becomes a {c_important}Centipede{/c} Skill that deals Poison damage. 

{c_important}Thunderspike{/c} leaves a trail of poison that deals {c_number}{payload:DOT_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage over {c_number}{SF_23}{/c} seconds.
